ayahs.text: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
ayahs.translation: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain

ayahs.text: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
ayahs.translation: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion

ayahs.text: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
ayahs.translation: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
ayahs.translation: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter

ayahs.text: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.translation: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not

ayahs.text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
ayahs.translation: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing

ayahs.text: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
ayahs.translation: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad

ayahs.text: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
ayahs.translation: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day

ayahs.text: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
ayahs.translation: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed

ayahs.text: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
ayahs.translation: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help

ayahs.text: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
ayahs.translation: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water

ayahs.text: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
ayahs.translation: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose

ayahs.text: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
ayahs.translation: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails

ayahs.text: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
ayahs.translation: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected

ayahs.text: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.translation: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth

ayahs.text: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

ayahs.text: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

ayahs.text: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
ayahs.translation: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity

ayahs.text: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
ayahs.translation: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees

ayahs.text: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

ayahs.text: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.translation: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings

ayahs.text: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
ayahs.translation: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness

ayahs.text: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
ayahs.translation: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar

ayahs.text: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
ayahs.translation: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar

ayahs.text: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
ayahs.translation: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience

ayahs.text: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
ayahs.translation: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed

ayahs.text: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
ayahs.translation: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her)

ayahs.text: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

ayahs.text: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
ayahs.translation: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

ayahs.text: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.translation: The folk of Lot rejected warnings

ayahs.text: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
ayahs.translation: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night

ayahs.text: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
ayahs.translation: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.translation: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
ayahs.translation: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning

ayahs.text: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: Now taste My punishment after My warnings

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.translation: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh

ayahs.text: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
ayahs.translation: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful

ayahs.text: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.translation: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures

ayahs.text: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
ayahs.translation: Or say they: We are a host victorious

ayahs.text: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
ayahs.translation: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee

ayahs.text: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
ayahs.translation: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure)

ayahs.text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
ayahs.translation: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
ayahs.translation: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell

ayahs.text: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
ayahs.translation: Lo! We have created every thing by measure

ayahs.text: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
ayahs.translation: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.translation: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth

ayahs.text: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.translation: And every thing they did is in the scriptures

ayahs.text: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
ayahs.translation: And every small and great thing is recorded

ayahs.text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
ayahs.translation: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers

ayahs.text: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
ayahs.translation: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King
